purpose: Identify economically comparable counties for each of the 35 active-project host counties using counties with zero known data-center facility or project records across the repository inventory, two pinned external national registries, and governed candidate-specific positive-exposure findings.
selection_rules: Exclude every county with one or more active canonical facilities in the current repository inventory.

Exclude every county linked to any operating, construction, permitted, proposed, or cancelled record in either pinned external national registry; these records are treated only as contamination screens, not as a separate analytical cohort.
Exclude every county with a governed candidate-specific positive-exposure finding supported by a cited operator, government, institutional, industry-directory, or research source.
Exclude all 35 active-project host counties from every comparison pool.
Require complete observations for every feature in the applicable five-year baseline window.
Use a project-anchor pre-period when available; otherwise use the labeled 2001–2005 structural-comparison window.
Rank candidates by weighted standardized feature distance with modest Census-region and division penalties.
interpretation_limits: A high match score means economic similarity under this specification; it does not verify absence of an unrecorded data center.

Three national inventories plus candidate-specific positive findings reduce false negatives but do not prove absence, so every surviving candidate still requires local facility-absence research before analytical use.
The available national panel does not yet include industry mix, urban-rural classification, electricity-market structure, tax policy, water conditions, or major concurrent investments.
These are descriptive comparison candidates, not causal estimates or finalized donor pools.
